description: 🏠 Apartment on the 3rd floor with lift❄️☀️ Reversible air conditioning🛋️ Bright and warm stay with sofa bed📺 TV and WiFi🍳 Fully equipped kitchen: hob, Nespresso machine, toaster, kettle, microwave, oven🛏️ Three bedrooms with queen-size beds🚿 Two shower rooms with toilet🚽 Separate toilet🧺 Towels and bed linen🫧Washing machine and dryerThe space🔑Access to this apartment is self-contained. However, we are available 7 days a week to help if you need us. You can contact us through the booking platform.Guest access✨🏠 The dream neighbourhood of Parisians!Beautiful luxurious apartment in the heart of Paris.Located in a prestigious area, you will be a 9-minute walk from the Palais Garnier and a 15-minute metro ride from Parc Monceau, the Champs-Élysées, Place de la Concorde and the Louvre.You will be completely won over by the comfort, standing and services offered by this exceptional apartment. 🏙️ The 8th arrondissement of Paris is one of the capital's main tourist and shopping districts. It's home to iconic landmarks, world-class museums, and chic residential neighborhoods. Walk the alleys of Place de la Concorde, discover the splendor of the Champs-Elysées, and admire the historic buildings that make the city famous. Tourists will also be able to enjoy the lively atmosphere of the surrounding streets such as Rue de Rivoli and the Seine.
